verdict.rationale: Circle Payments Network documents cross-border fiat payouts: you get real-time FX quotes, settle in USDC onchain, and payout partners deliver local fiat to the receiver. An OFI API endpoint returns the supported countries, currencies and payment methods, and Circle Mint converts USDC to and from USD. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the payout methods are bank transfers, the actual published list of countries and currencies (only an endpoint that returns them is evidenced), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, recipients can land in local fiat — documented off-ramp rails that convert stablecoins into bank transfers across a published set of currencies and countries

citations.quote: Send cross-border fiat payouts through a network of payout partners. Request real-time FX quotes, settle in USDC onchain, and let partners deliver local fiat to the receiver.
Returns the overview of supported countries, currencies, payment methods, blockchains.
Qualified businesses can apply for a Circle Mint account to readily convert USD to and from USDC at no additional cost.
